d: Finergi is a Dubai-based fintech and part of Optasia Group. We provide prepaid electricity advances and mobile financial services across sub-Saharan Africa. We work with utilities, mobile network operators, banks and payment providers.
We operate through several legal entities, in many markets, with different tax regimes and regulated partners. That makes accounting at Finergi more complex than our size suggests.
This role makes Finergi's numbers right, on time and audit-ready.

You will own month-end close, reporting, statutory accounts and controls across all our entities. You will take over day-to-day accounting from the Commercial Finance team, so they can focus on forecasting and deals.
We are looking for someone who can pick up our accounting framework and run it without daily direction. We want a person who develops and executes solutions, not one who waits for instructions.
You will also lead an important change: making SAP our single system of record, and moving off Xero.
q: Chartered Accountant, CA(SA) strongly preferred. ACCA or an equivalent qualification considered for UAE candidates.
6 or more years after qualifying, including at least 2 years running a month-end close as a controller or reporting accountant.
Strong IFRS knowledge, including revenue recognition and consolidation.
Experience across several legal entities and more than one country.
Hands-on experience with an ERP, ideally SAP.
Experience coordinating statutory audits and tax compliance with external advisors.
Able to work independently, and to set up processes where none exist.
Fintech, payments, mobile money or digital lending background.
Exposure to UAE corporate tax and VAT, or to tax in other African markets.
Experience moving a business from Xero or another small-business system to an ERP.
Experience working inside a larger group, with shared services and Group reporting deadlines.
The kind of person who will do well here
Owner, not follower. You see a gap, propose a fix and deliver it.
High standards on controls. You do not let a missing invoice or an unreconciled balance slide.
Comfortable with complexity. Many entities, markets and partners do not unsettle you.
Clear communicator. You can explain an accounting issue to a non-accountant in plain words.
Works well remotely, with a team in Dubai and colleagues across Africa.
r: Own the monthly close calendar and checklist, with fixed working-day deadlines aligned to Group.
Prepare month-end entries, journals, accruals, deferrals and prepayments, including the edge cases.
Reconcile every balance sheet account monthly, including bank accounts.
Produce the management accounts and the consolidation across entities.
Prepare the monthly Group reporting pack and respond to Group requests.
Book revenue correctly across both transaction legs (voucher principal and service fee), in line with our accounting policy and commercial framework.
Own SAP for Finergi as it goes live, including posting files, master data and period close.
Lead the move from Xero to SAP as our single system of record.
Bring SAP postings fully in-house from Optasia, once the process is stable.
Run quarterly reviews of SAP user access.
Review Optasia's revenue assurance and related workings, and make sure they are correctly brought into SAP.
Maintain the revenue and commission workbooks.
Run or review the reconciliations between our loan management system and partner wallets.
Raise partner invoices from validated data, and track receivables and collections.
Process supplier and contractor invoices, matched to a signed, current agreement or PO.
Manage the payables mailbox, supplier queries and missing documents.
Keep a register of supplier and contractor agreements, with expiry dates flagged early.
Prepare payment runs. Treasury initiates and the CFO approves.
Record vendor bank detail changes, which Treasury verifies independently.
Account for payroll across entities, including statutory deductions, journals and liability reconciliations.
Account for intercompany balances and Optasia recharges.
Account for intercompany funding, wallet deposits and FX.
Prepare statutory accounts for all entities, on one calendar.
Coordinate the external audit and manage the audit request list.
Coordinate tax compliance with in-country specialists, including UAE corporate tax and VAT, South African tax, and withholding taxes and tax clearance certificates across African markets.
Manage DMCC filings and the annual licence cycle, working with Company Secretarial.
Keep one compliance tracker for all filings, certificates and deadlines.
Run our finance controls in practice, including segregation of duties.
Check payments monthly against the Delegation of Authority.
Draft finance policies and technical accounting memos for CFO approval.
You have run one close alongside Commercial Finance, then owned the next one end to end.
Supplier and contractor invoices, the payables mailbox and payment run preparation are fully with you.
The review of Optasia's revenue output is in place every month.
A single compliance calendar covers all statutory, tax and DMCC deadlines.
The close is delivered on a fixed working-day deadline, every month.
SAP is the single system of record, and Xero is switched off.
The external audit closes on time, with no significant findings.
Every filing and tax certificate is current. No deadlines are missed.
What this role does not cover
Budgeting, forecasting and business cases. These sit with Commercial Finance.
Bank relationships, funding, payment initiation and FSP partners. These sit with Treasury and FSP.
Revenue assurance itself. This is carried out by Optasia. This role reviews the output.
Filing tax returns. In-country specialists file. This role coordinates and reviews.
Banks and payment partners, for reconciliations

d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

The Customer Service Associate plays a key role in delivering exceptional service to customers. Responsibilities include maintaining store standards, managing inventory, and assisting with sales. The role involves handling customer inquiries and complaints, ensuring the store is well-stocked and visually appealing, and operating the cash register in accordance with company policies. Success in this role is measured by customer satisfaction, sales performance, and the organization and cleanliness of the store.
q: What Qualifies You For The Role
Previous experience in customer-facing roles, especially in retail environments, focused on excellent service.
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with customers.
Ability to recommend products and actively engage in upselling and cross-selling.
Experience in operating cash registers and following cash handling procedures.
Ability to maintain high store standards, both in product organization and cleanliness.
Proven ability to work well within a team to achieve store goals.
We’re here to provide excellent service but a little help from you can ensure a five-star candidate experience from start to finish.

Before you click “apply”: Please read the job description carefully to ensure you can confidently demonstrate why this opportunity is right for you and take the time to put together a well-crafted and personalised CV to further boost your visibility. Our global Talent Acquisition team members are all assigned to specific businesses to ensure that we make the best matches between talent and opportunities. We not only consider the requisite compatibility of skills and behaviours, but also how candidates align with our Values of Respect, Integrity, Collaboration, and Excellence.
As part of our candidate experience promise, we also want to make ourselves available to you throughout the application process. We make every effort to review and respond to every application.
r: Engage with customers to provide a high level of service and assist with their needs.
Address basic customer complaints and escalate issues as needed.
Ensure that the store is well-organized and adheres to company visual merchandising standards.
Regularly clean and maintain the sales floor to create an inviting shopping environment.
Actively participate in receiving new shipments and restocking the store.
Help manage inventory and ensure the store is fully stocked.
Recommend products to customers based on their needs, focusing on upselling and cross-selling.
Stay updated on product information to make informed recommendations.
Operate the cash register, process transactions, and follow company policies for handling payments.
Ensure accurate cash handling and maintain a clean and organized checkout area.

d: DataRobot delivers AI that maximizes impact and minimizes business risk. Our platform and applications integrate into core business processes so teams can develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. DataRobot empowers practitioners to deliver predictive and generative AI, and enables leaders to secure their AI assets. Organizations worldwide rely on DataRobot for AI that makes sense for their business — today and in the future.

As the Principal AI Engineer within our Professional Services team, you will be a strategic leader and executive advisor, responsible for driving the technical vision and successful delivery of our most complex and strategic AI programs with our top-tier customers.

You will be part of a high-performing team of AI Engineers, establish architectural best practices for Agentic AI deployments, and ensure that all solutions translate into exceptional, measurable business value. This role requires a balance of deep technical expertise, a proven background in Software engineering practices and architectures with executive-level communication and P&L accountability for large professional service engagements.
q: Expertise in full-stack development, enterprise software architecture and the implementation of modern agentic AI frameworks.

Deep, proven expertise in defining and implementing end-to-end AI/ML and Generative AI application architectures, including Agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Llama Index), RAG, and large-scale predictive modeling systems.
Expertise in setting MLOps strategy for model CI/CD, governance, and enterprise-level scaling.
Deep proficiency in containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and building secure, production-grade REST APIs

Exceptional executive-level verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions, present complex technical roadmaps, and influence decision-makers across business and technology domains.
Demonstrable track record in a highly visible client-facing or consulting leadership role.
Requisite Education and Experience / Minimum Qualifications
Experience: Approximately 10+ years of progressive hands-on experience in Software development, Agentic AI frameworks, or a similar technical role.
Education: A CS Degree MS or Ph.D. preferred in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

Cloud Experience: Expert-level, hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on-premise deployment experience, with a focus on enterprise architecture and security.
DataRobot Experience: Expert familiarity with the DataRobot AI Platform is a strong plus.

r: Executive & Strategic Engagement: Serve as the most senior technical leader on major engagements, advising C-level executives and key stakeholders on their AI strategy, architectural roadmap, and governance model.

Program Ownership & Governance: Own the technical success of the Professional Services portfolio, setting the technical standards, ensuring solution quality, and overseeing the deployment of advanced AI applications, including Agentic AI and complex GenAI/RAG systems.

Technical Architecture & Standards: Define the architectural blueprint and MLOps best practices for building robust, scalable, and secure AI solutions that leverage the DataRobot platform and cutting-edge open-source tools.
